title: 江雪
author: Liu Zongyuan

translation: From a thousand hills, all birds have flown away
On ten thousand paths, not a footprint remains
A lone boat, an old man in straw cape and hat
Fishing alone, in the cold river snow

annotations.绝: to vanish completely — not a single bird remains
annotations.蓑笠: straw raincoat and bamboo hat — gear of an old fisherman

appreciation: In just twenty characters, Liu Zongyuan paints a vast empty world of snow, then zooms into one tiny figure: an old fisherman who refuses to leave. Written during the poet's political exile, the lonely fisherman becomes a symbol of stubborn dignity — the world may freeze and empty out, but he keeps fishing.
